hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && { _win=$(tmux display-message -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{window_id}' 2>/dev/null || true); tmux set-option -wu -t "$TMUX_PANE" @needs_attention 2>/dev/null; [ -n "$_win" ] && open -g "hammerspoon://dismissNotify?winKey=${_win}&force=1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; tmux refresh-client -S 2>/dev/null || true
